title: Quality Technical Director
text:
**Quality & Product Safety Lead**
driving the division’s end-to-end quality strategy across product safety, laboratory operations, manufacturing processes, customer support, and compliance. You’ll translate quality requirements into practical standards, ensuring issues are prevented at the source while risks are actively managed.
 
 
In this role, you lead and develop a high-performing technical quality team—building capability, setting clear performance expectations, and creating a culture of problem-solving and accountability. You will also strengthen supplier performance through structured quality requirements, effective escalation paths, and ongoing performance reviews.
 
 
Your day-to-day impact will be felt in how you address customer quality concerns: investigating root causes, coordinating corrective and preventive actions, and tracking results to closure. You’ll drive continuous improvement in product performance and operational effectiveness by using data-driven insights to refine processes, reduce variation, and strengthen compliance readiness.
 
 
**Key Expectations**

* Strong leadership of cross-functional quality and technical teams
* Deep understanding of product safety, lab/lifecycle processes, manufacturing quality, and compliance
* Root-cause investigation and CAPA discipline to resolve customer issues
* Proven supplier quality management and performance improvement
* Continuous improvement mindset using measurable quality outcomes
